Verification by an independent authorized reviewer, recorded with source and timestamp

closure_gates.exit_criteria: Verify an out-of-band identity/authority record and signed binding to the registered fingerprint; never infer identity from proof of possession alone.

closure_gates.exit_criteria: Register four distinct secp256k1 public keys, independently bind each key to its role, and obtain each role's DER signature over the same fresh evidence envelope.
Run production verifier with all five independently trusted public keys and real signatures; persist certificate and verifier output; independently re-verify certificate and replay protection.
